capability_notes.device_abi: Smart-card APDU/1 protocol + serve loop + br_platform read/write adapter; offline only, no network/telemetry.
capability_notes.sign_images: Ed25519 host-evaluation keys only; no guest signing (verify-only SVC).
capability_notes.step_bound: Default 4096-instruction budget; CLI run is fixed at 4096; APDU EXEC accepts a u32 budget; exhaustion -> trap 8 (BUDGET).
capability_notes.trust_chain: Mechanism present and exercised (issuer-key admission, signature verify, version monotonicity, requested&allowlist grant), but the root/production trust authority, card target/AID, and deployment authorization are external and blocking.

dependencies: OpenSSL 3 (-lcrypto: SHA256, EVP Ed25519, RAND_bytes, OPENSSL_cleanse)
guest_languages: MSSL/ASM-1 (text assembly; directives .profile SIM_CORE, .image_version N, .request_caps A|B, optional .data OFFSET HEX)
image_formats: BRIM/1-v3 (80-byte header, SHA-256 seal @32, Q17-MODEL-OPS-3 tag @64, optional 64-byte Ed25519 signature; max 51200 bytes)

build.notes: warning-clean under -Werror; built brctl, br_tests, br_sizes

integrity.notes: binds all 19 files except SHA256SUMS.txt itself

notes: 1,048,576-bit (128 KiB) registers/stack; full-width bignum ALU, but LOAD/STORE deliberately move only low 64 bits.
Each live VM allocates ~34.3 MB RAM (35,926,544 bytes) despite a 176-byte image -- budget accordingly for many concurrent fabric nodes.
Distribution size gate has only 95 bytes of headroom (109905/110000).
CLI result readback is hardwired to R2.low64; arbitrary readback needs serve + APDU STATE.
--image-version changes the BRIM header but not the payload SHA-256 seal (version is outside the sealed payload).
CLI 'run' is unauthenticated; signature/trust enforcement lives only on run-signed/update/serve paths.
Internal codename 'Q17': every image embeds ASCII tag 'Q17-MODEL-OPS-3' at offset 64; evidence/q17/ sidecar present.
Full canonical gate 'make clean operational && make sanitize' reproduced GREEN here; deploy image reproduced bit-for-bit; integrity 19/19 OK.

programmatic_drive.result_parse: stdout line 1: 'status=<u> trap=<u> ip=<u> image_version=<u> result=PASS|FAIL' (status=2 HALTED + trap=0 = success); line 2: 'R2.low64=<u64>' (guest result convention = register R2 low 64 bits). Exit 0 success / 1 fail / 2 bad-args. Arbitrary register/memory/stack readback (<=512B) via serve + APDU STATE {kind,index,offset:u32,length:u16}.
programmatic_drive.run_cmd: .build/brctl run prog.brimg   (fixed 4096-step budget; for custom budget use APDU EXEC cmd 4 with u32 budget via serve, or C API br_vm_run(vm,budget))

runtime_contract: Offline C11 SIM-core (smart-card/UICC-style) VM. ABI BRIM/1-v3 + APDU/1 + MSSL/ASM-1: wide-word ISA, 16-slot capability model, SHA-256-sealed and optionally Ed25519-signed BRIM images, 12-command APDU protocol, persistent host with dual-CRC state slots, atomic staged update, and verified recovery.
